newsitem.title: UK: Brent CFD's fall as ships seen heading to Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Brent CFD's fall as ships seen heading to Iraq.

text.p: Brent contract-for-difference's fell sharply on Wednesday as traders eyed a number of ships being arranged to load Iraqi crude.

"Everyone has suddenly realised that the crude will load very soon - in the next two or three days probably. Every ship that can reach Iraq in the August 16-25 period is on subs (booked subject to confirmation) with someone," one trader said.

Next week's August 11-15 CFD's started the day around evens with September but latest talk put the week 15 to 20 cents lower. August 18-22 lost around ten cents with the following two weeks down around eight cents apiece.
Outright September Brent on the IPE traded down some 17 cents at $19.35 a barrel at 1022 GMT.
"It was a bubble ready to burst. Iraqi crude is coming and finally people are realising it," anotber trader said.
Brent intermonth spreads fell with Sept/Oct and Oct/Nov both now valued around -10/-6 cents.
There was only one Brent cargo (August 21-23 loader) in the paper chains today. Tuesday's deals at Sept +18 cents and Sept +3 cents were now felt way above market.
Traders had mixed views on the supply/demand picture in Europe but most felt the next Brent deal would be done at a discount to September Brent.
"There was some uncertainty about one trader and whether he had some more shorts to cover but now we know he doesn't, the buying has just dried up," one equity holder said.
One U.S. refiner was heard to have at least three ships on subjects for loading in the August 16-25 period out of Ceyhan.
At least two other companies were heard fixing ships for the same port and one U.S.-based company with an ultra large crude carrier still on subs to arrive in Ceyhan in the August 6-8 period.

Iraq submitted a new oil pricing formula to the U.N. on Tuesday. The U.N. overseers are expected to submit the prices, with their recommendation, to the Security Council's sanctions committee later today.
The committee then has 48 hours to raise any objections to the formula or it automatically becomes valid.
